title: Gold replay 프레임 재사용과 세션 윈도 인덱싱
objective: 검증 완료된 GoldWindowInputs 프레임을 Gold replay의 유일한 입력으로 재사용하여 세션마다 Silver Parquet 전체 이력을 재스캔하는 병목을 제거하고, 동일한 PIT Gold/QVEF artifact만 publish한다.
assumptions: 완료 기준은 호출자가 지정한 validation_start부터 validation_end까지의 모든 KRX session이다. 현재 2016-01-01부터 2026-09-04까지의 범위와 60/20 lookback은 줄이지 않는다.
GoldWindowInputs는 manifest 검증·column projection·warmup 경계를 완료한 Polars frame이다. frames와 silver_root가 함께 오면 frame이 production replay 입력이고 silver_root는 provenance/fallback 용도다.
data/gold/stocks/.staging-d8a2c2fbc08af8d2cd0cf5c92e43d075는 중단 실행 증적이므로 자동 삭제·재사용·publish 입력으로 사용하지 않는다.
이번 변경은 repeated source scan 제거가 범위다. parity 측정 뒤에도 universe/QVEF Python 계산이 지배적일 때만 별도 spec에서 Polars/JIT를 검토한다.

changes.signature: def materialize_gold_window(*, calendar: SessionCalendar | None = None, security_master: pl.DataFrame | None = None, daily_market: pl.DataFrame | None = None, financial_facts: pl.DataFrame | None = None, corporate_actions: pl.DataFrame | None = None, investor_flow: pl.DataFrame | None = None, validation_start: date, validation_end: date, decision_time: datetime, artifact_root: Path, gold_root: Path | None = None, universe_policy: Any | None = None, qvef_policy: Any | None = None, silver_root: Path | None = None) -> GoldRunReport

requirements: Complete calendar/security_master/daily_market/financial_facts/corporate_actions frames select PITReplayReader.from_frames even when silver_root is supplied. This route must not call PITReplayReader.from_silver_root or issue a second Parquet scan. The silver_root-only fallback remains compatible.

Build one reusable session index for daily_market and investor_flow frames. A decision concatenates only the exact calendar-derived 60-session daily window including decision and prior 20-session flow window excluding decision, then applies available_at <= decision_time; it must not filter the entire daily/flow frame per session.

Preserve PIT semantics: aware timestamps; session <= decision_time; invalid/missing/non-comparable available_at fails closed; valid_from <= session <= valid_to (or null valid_to); financial facts filter to PIT-valid eligible company IDs; no fiscal-period shortcut admits a later correction.

Do not mutate supplied input frames. Use derived Polars frames/views; retain float64 financial/score values; keep direct public universe/QVEF APIs and lazy PITReplayReader.from_silver_root behavior compatible.

Each StreamingGoldWriter owns a unique staging directory and monotonic in-memory counter per kind. It must not glob existing staging for batch numbering and must never read, append to, delete, or publish from stale staging. close() publishes only its recorded rows after existing completeness checks pass.

No timeout, cap, sample, shorter date range, or reduced lookback. Interruptions leave prior staging untouched; final immutable Gold/QVEF paths are created only after the entire requested replay completes.
Log only major replay phase boundaries using flat [SYS]/[DATA] key-value records: frame row counts and completed-session progress/elapsed time. Do not log per instrument or alter outputs.

Acceptance is semantic parity plus a full caller-selected frame-route run: compare universe/QVEF row counts and canonical manifests with an approved baseline when one exists. Unit tests assert routing and bounded content, not wall-clock thresholds.

alternatives_considered: Continue lazy replay: rejected because every session scans historical daily, master, facts and actions Parquet again. The interrupted staging completed only 216 universe batches in about 64 minutes, roughly 16-28 seconds between sessions.
Use full frames without an index: rejected because repeatedly filtering 5,812,360 daily rows remains O(sessions x rows).
Shorten replay/lookback or impose timeout: rejected because it changes the financial completion criterion and PIT eligibility.
Reuse d8a2 staging: rejected because there is no verified resume manifest/session-digest contract, so cross-run batches can mix inputs.
Vectorize/JIT all universe/QVEF now: deferred; duplicate source scanning is the measured first-order failure and existing functions are the semantic oracle.
design_rationale.chosen_reason: GoldWindowInputs already pays the validated bounded-load cost and supplies compacted master/reference frames. Reuse it, index only session-keyed market/flow data, and retain existing universe/QVEF functions for semantic parity. Private staging removes stale-run interference without deleting retained evidence.
failure_modes: Frame routing bypasses available_at or master validity and creates look-ahead bias.
Timezone/date mismatch removes a required 60-session bar or admits a future row.
Restart overwrites or consumes prior batches and publishes incomplete/mixed Gold.
Optimization silently changes date range or lookback and makes artifact incomparable.

performance_budget.expected_data_scale: Measured latest Silver: 3,001 calendar sessions; daily_market 5,812,360 rows; security_master 6,002,526 rows before GoldWindowInputs compaction; financial_facts 72,316 rows; investor_flow 695 rows; corporate_actions 2,336 rows. Full caller-selected 2016-01-01 through 2026-09-04 range remains mandatory.
performance_budget.storage_format: Manifest-verified Hive Parquet input, reused Polars frames during replay, and private per-writer pickle staging before existing immutable Parquet publication.
performance_budget.dtype_precision: Persisted market, fact, feature and score numerics remain float64; timestamps remain timezone-aware; identifiers remain strings.
performance_budget.chunking_strategy: Build indexes once; per session materialize only its 60-session daily and 20-session flow windows plus PIT-valid compact master/facts/actions. Staging names are O(1), and no chunk omits a requested session.
performance_budget.acceleration_candidate: Polars frame partition/index reuse is selected first. If parity profiling still shows state-independent preparation dominant, evaluate separate Polars vectorization; JIT is not justified before that measurement.

def test_materialize_gold_window_uses_supplied_frames_with_silver_provenance(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta
    import polars as pl
    import src.data.gold as module
    from src.core.time import SessionCalendar
    from src.data.replay import PITReplayReader

    sessions = tuple(datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC) + timedelta(days=index) for index in range(3))
    frames = {'calendar': SessionCalendar(sessions), 'security_master': pl.DataFrame(), 'daily_market': pl.DataFrame(), 'financial_facts': pl.DataFrame(), 'corporate_actions': pl.DataFrame(), 'investor_flow': pl.DataFrame()}
    called = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(PITReplayReader, 'from_silver_root', classmethod(lambda cls, **_kwargs: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError('root replay must not run'))))
    monkeypatch.setattr(PITReplayReader, 'from_frames', classmethod(lambda cls, **kwargs: called.append(kwargs) or PITReplayReader.from_frames_for_test(**kwargs)))
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, 'build_gold_audit_manifest', lambda **_kwargs: type('Manifest', (), {'manifest_hash': 'a' * 64})())
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, 'write_gold_audit_artifact', lambda *_args, **_kwargs: None)

    report = module.materialize_gold_window(**frames, validation_start=date(2024, 1, 1), validation_end=date(2024, 1, 3), decision_time=sessions[-1], artifact_root=tmp_path, silver_root=tmp_path / 'silver')

    assert len(called) == 1
    assert report.universe_decisions_count == 0

scenarios.expected_behavior: Indexed frame replay returns exact 60/20 windows and excludes future-available data.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_frame_replay_index_returns_exact_windows_without_future_rows() -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
    import polars as pl
    from src.core.time import SessionCalendar
    from src.data.replay import PITReplayReader
    from src.features.contracts import QvefFeaturePolicy
    from src.strategy.universe import UniversePolicy

    sessions = tuple(datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC) + timedelta(days=index) for index in range(70))
    decision = sessions[-1]
    daily = pl.DataFrame([{'instrument_id': 'KRX:1', 'session': item, 'available_at': item, 'trading_value': 1.0} for item in sessions] + [{'instrument_id': 'KRX:future', 'session': decision, 'available_at': decision + timedelta(days=1), 'trading_value': 1.0}])
    flow = pl.DataFrame([{'instrument_id': 'KRX:1', 'session': item, 'available_at': item, 'foreign_net_value': 1.0} for item in sessions])
    reader = PITReplayReader.from_frames(calendar=SessionCalendar(sessions), security_master=pl.DataFrame(), daily_market=daily, investor_flow=flow, financial_facts=pl.DataFrame(), corporate_actions=pl.DataFrame())

    replay = reader.session_input(session=decision, decision_time=decision, universe_policy=UniversePolicy(), qvef_policy=QvefFeaturePolicy())

    assert replay.daily_market.filter(pl.col('instrument_id') == 'KRX:1').height == 60
    assert replay.daily_market.filter(pl.col('instrument_id') == 'KRX:future').height == 0
    assert replay.investor_flow['session'].to_list() == list(sessions[-21:-1])

scenarios.expected_behavior: New writer keeps a legacy staging file unchanged and assigns its own first batch number without directory globbing.
scenarios.test_skeleton:
def test_streaming_gold_writer_uses_private_staging_without_legacy_mix(tmp_path) -> None:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime
    from src.core.datasets import DatasetCertification
    from src.data.replay import StreamingGoldWriter
    from src.strategy.universe import ExclusionReason, UniverseDecision

    session = datetime(2024, 1, 2, tzinfo=UTC)
    legacy = tmp_path / 'gold' / '.staging-c'
    legacy.mkdir(parents=True)
    legacy.joinpath('batch-00000.pkl').write_bytes(b'legacy')
    writer = StreamingGoldWriter(root=tmp_path / 'gold', dataset_id='c' * 64, decision_time=session, certification=DatasetCertification.RESEARCH, source_hashes={'calendar': 'c', 'security_master': 'm'}, expected_sessions=(session,), require_scores=False)

    writer.append_universe((UniverseDecision(session, 'KRX:1', False, (ExclusionReason.MISSING_MASTER,), 0, None),))

    assert legacy.joinpath('batch-00000.pkl').read_bytes() == b'legacy'
    assert writer._universe_batches[0].parent != legacy
    assert writer._universe_batches[0].name == 'batch-00000.pkl'
